comment: Terminology glossary (SDP-2.3 §4.11, REQ-L10N-16/17, DN-62). Each term must translate the same way everywhere in a locale; the per-locale files <tag>.json give the chosen translation. Keys are the en values below. Capitalised keys are named UI places (menus, ribbon tabs, docks, logs) and are translated as names; lower-case keys are ordinary words. Do-not-translate tokens (dnt.json) are never terms here.

terms.def: one view area inside a multiport that shows layers (an image panel, a 3D panel, a map panel)
terms.note: The UI word. Not the same as dock.

terms.def: older and documentation name for a panel inside a multiport
terms.note: Translate the same as panel; the UI says panel.
